command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS round 15, backbone-alone path reads no size (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 47)

metrics.arm: P_nsz: P_nom's flags + --bbnosize; object term retrained, target term reused from <cond>_tdc; seeds 10-12; builds full, nobottle, noplate and the S3 creations
metrics.layer2_go: pp_l2's mapping, unchanged (S1 as restated; S2 3F + OM in both layouts; S3 ratio >= 0.8, LB >= 0.6, both atoms, both layouts, k in {1, 5, 10})
metrics.metric: bottle_hold_new: new-layout hold pooled over K4, K5, N4, N5, N6, seeds pooled; P_nsz - P_nom, 2,000-draw state bootstrap (pp_round_read.py --tag r15 --metric bottle_hold_new --ref-s2 pp_r14_roll:P2nom)
metrics.reported_no_verdict: bottle_hold_new vs P_rtr (tag r15vrtr, ref pp_r13_roll:P2rtr); k5_hold_new vs P_nom (tag r15k5); familiar non-regression vs P_nom ('regresses' iff CI upper bound < 0); per-pairing 3F; pp_far_diag.py bb on seed 10
metrics.round_verdict: improves iff delta > 0.10 and the CI lower bound > 0
metrics.s1_restated: S1 holds iff, with every target part's m fixed to v for each v in the inventory, both swap tests and every target-into-grasp component are exactly 0 for every seed
metrics.states: dev: N2 main states 4-23, N2 seeds
metrics.written_before: the round's S1 read and any of its rollouts
